about: Port Moody is a city at the eastern end of Burrard Inlet in Metro Vancouver, between Coquitlam and Burnaby Mountain. It grew as a Canadian Pacific railway terminus and mill town and now markets itself as a City of the Arts, with an inlet shoreline, Rocky Point Park, and a row of breweries. Inlet Centre SkyTrain has pulled new housing toward the water. About 34,000 people live in Port Moody.
seoSummary: Metro Vancouver inlet city at the east end of Burrard Inlet, a former mill town now known for Rocky Point and breweries.
